title: Pressure is not an airflow reading
headline: PRESSURE IS
NOT AN
AIRFLOW READING
KEEP DESIGN
AND FIELD
PRESSURE DISTINCT
support: Measured TESP is not design ASP.

technicalLimit: TESP alone does not establish airflow; manufacturer-defined measurement boundary and operating condition matter. Measured TESP is not design ASP. No diagnostic or test-location prescription.
linkedin:
A pressure reading needs context.

Total external static pressure (TESP) does not independently establish airflow. Airflow evaluation needs the correct equipment data and operating conditions. Measured TESP is also distinct from design available static pressure (ASP).

The existing free AnyHVAC Airflow & Static Pressure Measurement guide explains these boundaries and connects measurements to practical tool inputs.

Read the guide:
https://www.anyhvac.net/resources/airflow-static-pressure-measurement

Save this carousel for your next measurement review.
